macros.name: accepted
macros.doc: The date on which the submission was accepted for publication.

macros.name: affil
macros.doc: The affiliation (institution, company) of the immediately preceding author(s).

macros.name: email
macros.doc: We provide an \email command for displaying the email address of the corresponding author.

macros.name: flushleftright
macros.doc: The \flushleftright layout restores full justification, in case it is needed.

macros.name: issue
macros.doc: The number of the IJDC issue in which the submission will be published.

macros.name: raggedyright
macros.doc: The \raggedyright layout more or less lays text out as with full justification, but then lets the shorter lines relax a bit from the right margin.

macros.name: raggedyright
macros.doc: The \raggedyright layout more or less lays text out as with full justification, but then lets the shorter lines relax a bit from the right margin.

macros.name: received
macros.doc: The date on which the initial submission was received by the editorial team (IJDC papers only).

macros.name: revised
macros.doc: The date on which the latest revision was received by the editorial team.

macros.name: submitted
macros.doc: The date on which the initial submission was made to the conference by the authors.

macros.name: subno
macros.doc: The submission number allocated by the IJDC Open Journal System.

macros.name: thecorrespondence
macros.doc: The macro \thecorrespondence is used in the title page footer for the name, postal address and email address of the corresponding author.

macros.name: title
macros.doc: The long version of the title is shown on the cover page of the submission, while the short version appears in the (even page) headers.

macros.name: title
macros.doc: The long version of the title is shown on the cover page of the submission, while the short version appears in the (even page) headers.

macros.name: volume
macros.doc: The number of the IJDC volume in which the submission will be published.
